**Welcome to the Warcraft Wiki !**  
The free _Warcraft_ wiki encyclopedia with 337,729 pages that **anyone** can edit!

The _Warcraft_ universe is a high-fantasy franchise developed by Blizzard Entertainment . Set in the richly detailed world of Azeroth and beyond , the main storyline revolves around the conflicts between diverse races such as humans , orcs , elves , and the undead . The original game, _Warcraft: Orcs & Humans_ , released in 1994, pioneered the real-time strategy (RTS) genre. It was followed by sequels and expansions , including _Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness_ and _Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos_ .

In 2004, the franchise expanded with _World of Warcraft_ (WoW), an immensely popular massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) that continues to receive new expansions, the latest being _Midnight_ . The _Warcraft_ universe also encompasses novels , comics , a feature film") , and various licensed merchandise, further immersing fans into its epic tales of heroism, magic , and conflict .

### Icon-popular.svg Featured article  [nominate ]

Thoradin's Wall in the Arathi Highlands

The **Empire of Arathor** , also known as the **Arathorian Empire** or **Arathi Empire** , was the first great human civilization, which existed in the northern Eastern Kingdoms between 2,800 and 1,200 years before the First War . Humanity—descendants of the vrykul race—had lived as scattered tribes of warring nomads for millennia before the Arathi tribe and their king, Thoradin , united them under a single banner in response to the threat posed by the forest trolls of the Amani Empire . During the Troll Wars , the high elves of Quel'Thalas") allied with Arathor and introduced the humans to arcane magic, allowing the two races to thoroughly defeat the Amani.

Over the following centuries, the proliferation of magic allowed Arathor to expand across the Eastern Kingdoms through the founding of multiple city-states which over time grew increasingly autonomous. The empire ultimately collapsed into the seven human kingdoms of the modern day: Stromgarde") , Dalaran") , Gilneas") , Alterac") , Kul Tiras") , Lordaeron") , and Stormwind") . These nations were not united again until the founding of the Alliance of Lordaeron over a millennium later. At some point before its collapse, a group of humans left Arathor and founded another successor state called the Arathi Empire on another continent beyond the Storming Sea .

↑ _World of Warcraft API_

Returns the number of total and online guild members.

```
numTotal , numOnline = GetNumGuildMembers ()
```

## Returns

    numTotal
    number \- Total number of players in the guild, or 0 if not in a guild.
numOnline
    number \- Number of players currently online, or 0 if not in a guild.

## Example

Shows the total headcount of your guild and the number of online and offline people.

```
local numTotal , numOnline = GetNumGuildMembers () 
 print ( format ( "%d guild members: %d online, %d offline" , numTotal , numOnline , numTotal - numOnline ))
```

## Details

* You may need to call C\_GuildInfo.GuildRoster() first in order to obtain correct data. May return wrong values immediately after quitting a guild. Maximum returned value is 500.
* This returns values of this API seem to be no longer affected by SetGuildRosterShowOffline )()

## Patch changes

*  **Patch 10.2.0 (2023-11-07):** Removed `numOnlineAndMobileMembers` return value.

Inviting a player to a guild requires a guild rank with permission from the Guild Master to recruit new members.

If you have the ability to invite new members there are 2 basic ways to do it:

* Use the Slash Command : /ginvite _<player\_name>_
* Use the Guild pane of the Friends List window:
  
    1. Click Add Member button (bottom-right of the window).
    2. Enter player name to invite to guild and click Invite.

Returns the number of players in the group.

```
numMembers = GetNumGroupMembers([groupType])
```

## Arguments [ [](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwowpedia.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FAPI_GetNumGroupMembers%3Faction%3Dedit%26section%3D1&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit") ]

    groupType
    number ?

    If omitted, defaults to `INSTANCE` if applicable, `HOME` otherwise.

|Value |Enum |Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
|1 |LE\_PARTY\_CATEGORY\_HOME |Home-realm group, i.e. a manually created group. |
|2 |LE\_PARTY\_CATEGORY\_INSTANCE |Instance-specific temporary group, e.g. Battlegrounds, Dungeon Finder |

## Returns [ [](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwowpedia.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FAPI_GetNumGroupMembers%3Faction%3Dedit%26section%3D2&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit") ]

    numGroupMembers
    number \- total number of players in the group (either party or raid), 0 if not in a group.
